summary: The C1 composer shows a Stop pill beside Send while the runtime can cancel the active run; Escape in the composer stops too. The web app wires Stop to the agent's interrupt and Interrupt in the Agent menu no longer asks to confirm.

compatibility.detail: EmbraceComposer without host `actions` renders Stop (data-testid run-stop, aria-label 'Stop run'/'Stopping run', aria-keyshortcuts Escape) whenever composer.canCancel is true, and Escape in the composer calls composer.cancel() once; an Escape that ends an IME composition never stops, and the default input's own cancelOnEscape is off so Escape cannot cancel twice. Hosts with their own `actions` keep owning their stop. New optional prop `stopRefusal` shows why a stop was refused and re-enables Stop. The web conversation runtime now has onCancel: agentControls.interrupt(agentRef), only when the source offers agent controls; a refusal is scoped to the running turn, cleared when that run ends, and a late answer for an older run is dropped.
